lines.en: Grandpa, our checkup papers came yesterday.
Oh, good. Is my blood pressure normal?
Yes, your pressure is fine. Mine is a little high.
lines.ko: 네, 혈압은 괜찮아요. 제 건 조금 높아요.

lines.en: What about your glucose level?
It's normal. Last month it was a little high.
And my cholesterol? Was it abnormal again?
No, it came down after your long walks.
That's good news. What about the scan?
The scan was clean when the doctor read it.
lines.ko: 의사 선생님이 보실 때 촬영 검사는 깨끗했어요.

lines.en: Thank you for the good news. I will keep walking.
Good morning. Are you here for a checkup?
Yes. I came this morning without breakfast.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 아침도 안 먹고 왔어요.

lines.en: Good. The fasting test needs an empty stomach.
What will you check first?
First your blood pressure, then a small blood sample.
lines.ko: 먼저 혈압을 재고, 그다음에 피를 조금 뽑아요.

lines.en: Does the sample show my glucose and cholesterol?
Yes, both levels. Your last one was normal.
lines.ko: 네, 두 수치 다요. 지난번엔 정상이었어요.

lines.en: That's good. Is the scan room near here?
It's down the hall. Please wait here for now.
lines.ko: 복도 끝에 있어요. 여기서 잠시 기다려 주세요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will sit near the window.
